title: Grateful Dead Live at Gulfstream Park Racetrack on 1968-12-29
lineage: SBD > MC > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1968 Miami Pop Festival set, highlighted by a scorching The Other One and blistering Eleven.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers surprisingly clear, well‑balanced sound for its era, letting the band’s ferocious late‑'68 performance shine through. Highlights include an explosive The Other One, a fire‑breathing Eleven, a tight Dark Star and a concise Lovelight, all delivered with relentless drive despite the short, festival‑rushed set length.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 4–5 stars and praise both the musical intensity and the surprisingly good sound quality; only a few note minor mix issues, resulting in an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear for a 1968 SBD source; some reviewers mention slight over‑mixing in the right ear or occasional minor drop‑outs, but overall very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, quick‑paced set typical of a festival sunset slot; the short runtime feels rushed but the second half builds into intense jams that keep the momentum rolling.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for incendiary, manic leads—especially on The Other One and Eleven—with many calling his playing "on fire" and "perfect tone."
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for focused interplay with Jerry during the Eleven jam; a few reviewers comment on his solid bass contribution.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums receive special mention in the drums>Other One>Cryptical segment and are described as powerful, driving the intensity of the performance.
